# Build B2B LinkedIn System

> An evidence-first Codex skill for company positioning, technical content, ICP definition, same-industry and same-skill relationship matrices, buyer/peer/partner discovery, approval-gated outreach, CTA-to-CRM handoff, and a 30-day rollout.

## Canonical resources

- Repository: https://github.com/mars-tw/build-b2b-linkedin-system
- Skill entrypoint: https://github.com/mars-tw/build-b2b-linkedin-system/blob/main/skills/build-b2b-linkedin-system/SKILL.md
- Latest release: https://github.com/mars-tw/build-b2b-linkedin-system/releases/latest
- License: https://github.com/mars-tw/build-b2b-linkedin-system/blob/main/LICENSE

## Behavioral contract

- Separate verified facts, supported material, hypotheses, and missing inputs.
- Never turn examples into company claims.
- Never invent product specifications, certifications, customers, results, or prospect activity.
- Keep AI-generated content as a draft until a qualified human reviews it.
- Require explicit authorization before publishing, messaging, changing profiles, or writing CRM data.
- Optimize for buyer trust and qualified conversations, not vanity metrics or activity volume.
- Separate official platform statements, local observations, practitioner analysis, and hypotheses.
- Never claim LinkedIn's exact private algorithm, fixed weights, guaranteed outcomes, or a fixed safe invitation quota.
- Separate buyers, peers, partners, suppliers, competitors, internal people, unknowns, and exclusions.
- Treat priority as a research decision, never permission to contact.
- Never use sensitive targeting, scraping, bots, undocumented APIs, session-cookie reuse, bulk actions, fake engagement, or limit evasion.
- Keep discovery, verification, classification, queue, exact approval, execution, and observation as separate states.

## Validation

Run `python tools/validate_skill.py` locally with Python 3.10 or newer. The repository does not claim a hosted CI gate; the portable local validator is the current automated quality gate.
